description: Build Worker config, state store, and localized CLI
notes: Added worker config/state modules, data directory persistence, locale/runner/retention settings, localized CLI dispatch for worker status/install/start/stop and config set, plus persistence tests.

description: Implement self-signed TLS lifecycle and pairing
notes: Implemented IP-SAN self-signed certificate generation/fingerprint, one-time expiring pairing codes, token hashing with timing-safe authentication/revocation, CLI install/status/tls rotate integration, and certificate/pairing tests.

description: Add token authentication and encrypted secret storage
notes: Added AES-256-GCM SecretStore with restrictive master-key/file permissions, provider/version rotation, metadata-only listing, revoke, and authenticated tamper rejection tests. Pairing token authentication remains hash-only and revocable.

description: Implement HTTPS artifact and manifest endpoints
notes: Added immutable artifact storage with path/size/hash enforcement and an HTTPS Worker server exposing health, one-time pairing, authenticated manifest, artifact upload/download, and auth rejection. Real TLS server integration test passes.

description: Implement WSS task lifecycle and reconnect stream
notes: Implemented WorkerTaskManager queue/active-task policy, structured event cursors, followUp/steer input recording, abort/activation, and WSS auth/frame routing with reconnect replay. Real WebSocket integration test passes.

description: Integrate Pi RPC execution and persistent task queue
notes: Integrated Pi RPC-compatible child execution with streaming stdout/stderr events, prompt/steer/followUp forwarding, abort handling, exit settlement, persisted task records, restart loading, and server lifecycle wiring. Execution can be disabled for transport-only tests.

description: Add Docker and host execution runners
notes: Added HostRunner and DockerRunner abstraction and wired PiRpcExecutor to use configured runner. Docker execution uses isolated network, read-only root, and only the task cwd bind-mounted.

description: Add systemd install, retention, and cleanup commands
notes: Added systemd unit rendering/install output, worker serve/start/stop/cleanup CLI paths, configurable retention-days, and expired task directory cleanup with tests.

description: Complete Worker security and integration tests
notes: Added unauthorized WSS regression coverage, Docker isolation argument test, hardened WebSocket shutdown, retention/systemd tests, npm audit validation, TypeScript check, full 28-test suite, and pack smoke verification. Remaining lens findings are non-blocking complexity warnings in the WebSocket coordinator.
